'''Achtnak''' was a stealthy [[Diet/Legends|predator]] native to the [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]],<ref name="GW" /><ref name="CE" /> located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &ndash; based on corresponding data for [[Tepasi system/Legends|Tepasi system]]</ref> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]],<ref name="Marvel-Vader-Arc">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of the 1977 [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] comic series to the first few months of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], while ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events up until [[Star Wars (1977) 35|issue 35]] to before ''[[Star Wars: Vader's Quest]]'' and ''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]'', which it dates to two months after the Battle of Yavin.</ref> [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]] committed millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to construct a [[Achtnak Turbine Station|base]] that would generate a vortex within the [[Atmosphere/Legends|troposphere]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]]. Orman Tagge named the constructed station after a predator from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Tepasi.<ref name="GW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Achtnak was introduced in the [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GW" />
